<div class="card-body">
'''Leia Organa''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Leia Organa]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4030). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レイア・オーガナ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スターで、彼女と同じ位置にいる反乱軍の戦闘力に＋１。外交特権により、耐：損耗＜２。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-leia-organa-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">意志の強いオルデランのプリンセス。史上最年少の帝国元老院議員。外交特権を使って反乱軍のスパイをする。ラルティアの反乱活動を支援した。天性のリーダー。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Leia Organa.

'''Card text:''' On the Death Star, Rebels at the same site as her are power +1. Her diplomatic immunity gives her immunity to attrition less than 2.

'''Lore:''' A strong-willed princess of Alderaan and the youngest member of the Imperial Senate in history. She uses diplomatic immunity to spy for the Rebels. She supported Rebel activity on Ralltiir. A natural leader.
